title: UnitedHealthcare Benefit Ecosystem
summary: Describes the UnitedHealthcare Benefit Ecosystem, an API-based approach that connects UnitedHealthcare with benefits administration platforms to streamline quoting, enrollment and renewal.

assets.alt: Packaged Savings for Fully Insured 2-99 flier

atoms.title: What the Benefit Ecosystem is
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare Benefit Ecosystem?
atoms.text: The UnitedHealthcare Benefit Ecosystem is designed to move away from manually intensive, time-consuming, error-prone benefits administration. Benefits administrators can look forward to real-time integration, streamlined enrollment and automated processing for eligibility and renewal. It creates stronger connections between UnitedHealthcare and leading benefits administration platforms.
questions: What is the UnitedHealthcare Benefit Ecosystem?
How does UnitedHealthcare streamline benefits administration?

atoms.title: UnitedHealthcare API Marketplace access
atoms.question: How do brokers access the Benefit Ecosystem?
atoms.text: The way into the benefits administration platform is through the UnitedHealthcare Application Programming Interface (API) Marketplace. It acts as the door where external stakeholders can securely access and use available APIs, and on the front end only licensed and appointed brokers and consultants are allowed in.
questions: Who can use the UnitedHealthcare API Marketplace?
How do I connect a benefits platform to UnitedHealthcare?

atoms.title: Automation and real-time data sharing
atoms.question: What does the Benefit Ecosystem automate?
atoms.text: Easier benefits administration in the UnitedHealthcare Benefit Ecosystem begins with automation. Automated tasks help eliminate hours of work, information may be shared in real time when the customer needs it, and available API integration continues to grow based on the needs of the benefits administration firm.
questions: Does the Benefit Ecosystem share data in real time?
How much work does benefits automation save?

atoms.title: Benefit Ecosystem advantages for brokers and consultants
atoms.question: How does the Benefit Ecosystem help brokers and consultants?
atoms.text: For brokers and consultants, the Benefit Ecosystem simplifies setting up UnitedHealthcare policies on connected benefits administration platforms. It makes it easier to generate quotes, capture employee elections and enrollment, renew plans and more. It also reduces manual work for agency staff and helps eliminate errors.
questions: Can brokers quote UnitedHealthcare through a benefits platform?
How does the Benefit Ecosystem reduce errors?

atoms.title: Benefit Ecosystem value by audience
atoms.question: How does the Benefit Ecosystem help employers, benefits administrators and members?
atoms.text: For employers, it automates information entry for greater accuracy and fewer member and HR issues, helps simplify benefits management and speeds up data sharing. For benefits administrators, it helps enable instant access to data, increases operational efficiency and drives more value for clients. For members, it helps improve the enrollment experience, supports digital adoption and eases access to coverage information at the point of service.
questions: What does the Benefit Ecosystem do for HR teams?
How does the Benefit Ecosystem improve member enrollment?

atoms.title: Quoting API and Benefits details API
atoms.question: What do the Quoting API and Benefits details API do?
atoms.text: The Quoting API allows electronic quotes to be transmitted to the digital aggregator tool. The Benefits details API offers benefit and product-level details. Both are among the key enhancements designed to streamline the UnitedHealthcare benefits administration experience.
questions: Which API provides product-level benefit details?

atoms.title: Customer API and single sign-on
atoms.question: What do the Customer API interface and single sign-on provide?
atoms.text: The Customer API interface provides customer-level information such as eligibility rules and demographics. Single sign-on (SSO) allows access to member websites for benefits, claims, wellness, evidence of insurability and more. Both are key enhancements in the UnitedHealthcare Benefit Ecosystem.
questions: What customer information does the Customer API provide?
Does the Benefit Ecosystem support single sign-on?

atoms.title: UnitedHealthcare Sourcebook for enrollment content
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare Sourcebook?
atoms.text: The UnitedHealthcare Sourcebook is described as a one-stop resource for enrollment content. It provides grab-and-go content for building a client's benefit administration experience, including direct links to provider directories, education content, ongoing member communications and more, gathered in one place and kept updated.

atoms.title: Strategic alliances and how to get help
atoms.question: How can brokers learn more about Benefit Ecosystem alliances?
atoms.text: Brokers can contact benefit_ecosystem@uhc.com or their UnitedHealthcare representative for more information. The page lists strategic alliance fliers for benefits administration platforms Employee Navigator and ADP, plus Packaged Savings fliers for fully insured 2-99 groups and for PRIME and FACETS 2-99 groups.
